content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@A, Analysis.Seq)), list-partial(Analysis.bounded(F), Analysis.boundedAbove(F), Analysis.boundedBelow(F)), Logic.exists-typed(@M, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(M), Logic.forall-typed(@x, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(x, Analysis.domain(F)), $\left|#0\right| < #1$(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), x), M))))))
content.markdown:
`F` is bounded iff some `M > 0` dominates `|F.map x|` for every `x` in `F.domain`; bounded above and bounded below drop the absolute value and keep one inequality.

For a sequence the same definition is relative to the index window: on a finite window the quantifier ranges over `[A.init, A.final)`, on an infinite one over `[A.init, ∞)`. Because the bound is only required on the carrier's own region, a function that blows up outside its domain is still bounded.
